cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
cards.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. What keeps the soup inside that upside-down bowl? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then turn the spoon over. Let's test which thing owns down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the spoon sets the direction. Point it into the sink before we try putting it down.

mechanism: A manages serving lunch and shares a controlled test to find the rule governing soup in an inverted bowl.
confusable: Unlike pretending to know an investigation already, A tests unknown behavior and uses the observed result for a practical next move.
comparison: Object orientation at lunch differs from intention-following shadow navigation.
